decisions.ADR-008: The Link protocol policy. A positive, closed allowlist: an absolute http: or https: URL, parsed with `new URL` rather than pattern-matched. Everything else — javascript:, vbscript:, data:, file:, blob:, protocol-relative //host/x, relative paths, fragments, mailto:, tel: — degrades to plain text with no href, no target and no handler.
decisions.divergenceFromUpstream: Deliberate and recorded. Upstream's predicate is /^(https?:\/\/|mailto:|tel:|\/|#)/i, which ALLOWS protocol-relative //evil.example.com/x, mailto:, tel:, root-relative paths and fragments. The fork is strictly stricter: every target it refuses is also refused by upstream except those five. Verified against both predicates, not read off the source.
decisions.noHostTokenForLinkColour: No single host token clears AA in both schemes. --primary is 4.23:1 on white; the static brand steps are 3.39-3.53:1 on the dark surface. Declared as LINK_LITERAL (a light-dark pair drawn from the host's brand scale) rather than a var() bridge that would silently fail in one scheme — the same reasoning as SERIES_4_LITERAL.

defectsFound.title: A nested ListItem drew two rows for one item
defectsFound.foundBy: reading the live page, not a test — the screenshot appeared to show both a bullet and a check before 'Nested title'
defectsFound.detail: List([ListItem(...)]) produced TWO role="listitem" elements: the walker drew the ListItem into a complete row, and List then wrapped that row in a second one. The live card showed 5 rows for a 4-item program, markers ['1.','2.','3.','•','✓'], with the bullet row containing the check row.
defectsFound.howConfirmed: tests/diag-list-rows.spec.tsx (throwaway) printed row counts per item shape: 'one ListItem, check rows=2'. After the fix: rows=1.
defectsFound.fix: Renderer signature gained the raw argument list; List consults the raw descriptor to decide whether an entry IS a ListItem, rather than inspecting the node it already drew into.
defectsFound.regression: tests/openui-text-4a2.spec.tsx — 'draws a nested ListItem as exactly one row' and 'draws N plain items as N rows'
defectsFound.verifiedAfterFix: live browser: listRows 4, markers ['1.','2.','3.','✓'] in both schemes

defectsFound.title: --font-mono does not exist in the host
defectsFound.foundBy: measuring the candidate tokens before writing the renderer, prompted by D17/D18
defectsFound.detail: The frame vocabulary declares --font-mono (src/frame-css.ts:47) but the host document does not. Bridging to it would have been D17/D18 a fourth time: a var() that resolves to nothing still paints a fallback.
defectsFound.evidence: host-mono-tokens.json — --font-mono and --dsw-font-mono both absent; --dsw-font-markdown-code-font-family resolves to a real mono stack
defectsFound.fix: --font-mono is bridged to --dsw-font-markdown-code-font-family, measured to resolve on the live page
defectsFound.guard: the 4A-1 verified-token allowlist rejected the new name until it was added with this measurement behind it

defectsFound.title: Three 4A-2 colours failed AA in the light scheme
defectsFound.foundBy: measuring contrast against the effective backdrop instead of eyeballing the screenshot
defectsFound.detail: Link 4.23:1 (--primary is a surface fill, not a text colour), copy button 3.71:1 and list marker 3.71:1 (both inherited --muted-foreground, which bridges to the host's tertiary tier).
defectsFound.fix: Link moved to its own --link literal (5.39:1 light / 5.42:1 dark); the small supporting text moved to a new --muted-foreground-strong bridging the host's secondary tier (5.8:1 light / 12.11:1 dark)
defectsFound.notChanged: --muted-foreground itself is left alone. It is the 4A-1 tier used by Caption, which is browser-verified; this batch does not get to silently restyle it.

defectsFound.title: evaluate() did not retry transient observation refusals
defectsFound.foundBy: a real run failed with 'strict observation changed before this action'
defectsFound.detail: The documented policy is that a moving page is never a product failure, but only step() implemented it. A plain evaluate() against a live conversation failed the whole run on a page that had merely repainted.
defectsFound.fix: evaluate() retries observation_changed / content changed / covered / control_context_invalid, and re-throws anything else immediately
defectsFound.guard: node evidence/lib/parity.mjs still exits 0; no capability lost, per-character typing still forbidden
